inputs.prompt: The exact same anime girl as the provided reference images, identical face, hairstyle, outfit and body proportions. Full body standing, identical framing and constant subject scale. Static locked camera, flat unchanged lighting and exposure. A solid uniform chroma key green background matching the reference, no background shadows or gradients. Keep the head, torso, hips and feet at the same screen positions; only the specifically requested local motion is allowed. Preserve clean stable fingers and garment details. No zoom, camera motion, body resizing, walking, scene changes, extra limbs, extra objects, text, overlays, glow, particles or motion blur. Small fluent movements with gentle acceleration and deceleration, no sudden pose changes. One gentle continuous transition from the first resting reference to the final held reference. Raise the requested hand pose once, following a smooth short path. Begin slowly, move calmly and settle into the final pose without overshoot. Keep the lips closed and the eyes open. No speaking, blinking, nodding, repeated emphasis or extra hand movement. The final held pose must match the final reference in wrist, elbow, finger and shoulder positions. This is a one-shot transition and must not return to the first pose.
